title: Cheesy Bao Sandwich
description: A simple and delicious sandwich made with melted cheese and wrapped in a soft bao bun.
instructions: Cut the bao buns in half and toast them in the oven for 2-3 minutes.
In a pan, melt 1 tablespoon of light mayonnaise over medium heat.
Add the shredded Colby cheese to the pan and stir until melted.
Add the shredded Jack cheese to the pan and stir until melted.
Add the shredded Chinese cabbage to the pan and stir until wilted.
Assemble the sandwiches by spreading the cheese mixture onto the toasted bao buns.
